porch.line: We fell asleep on Beulah's porch
stanza: Always for you, forever yours
It felt just like the old days
We fell asleep on Beulah's porch
I'm gonna take it with me when I go

porch.line: And we'd sit out on the screen porch
stanza: Mother liked her white wine
She'd have a glass or three
And we'd sit out on the screen porch
White winos mom and me
We'd talk about her childhood
Recap my career
When we got to my father
That was when I'd switch to beer
We got to the old man
And I'd always switch to...

porch.line: Been there drinking on that front porch
stanza: Seen him playing in his backyard
Young boy just starting out
So much history in this landscape
So much confusion, so much doubt
Been there drinking on that front porch
Angry kids, mean and dumb
Looks like a painting, that blue skyline
God hates fags where we come from

porch.line: And she drew little Bobby who would come to sweep the porch
porch.linePrev: Traded in her yellow chalk for charcoal sticks
porch.lineNext: And she drew the mailman, delivered everyday at 4

porch.line: Will you kiss me on the porch
stanza: Yeah, I showed up at your party
Will you have me? Will you love me?
Will you kiss me on the porch
In front of all your stupid friends?
If you kiss me, will it be just like I dreamed it?
Will it patch your broken wings?
I'm only seventeen, I don't know anything
But I know I miss you
